ais.name: Deterministic Engine
ais.desc: Absolute order. Every input follows fixed IF-THEN law; the same facts always produce the same verdict. No guessing, no chance — a mind of pure rules.
caps: Fires IF-THEN rule chains with full trace
Zero randomness — identical input, identical output
Explains every verdict step by step
Verifies other AIs for paradox and contradiction

ais.name: Probabilistic Mind
ais.desc: A mind of odds. Nothing is certain — everything is a belief updated by evidence. It weighs likelihoods the way a gambler weighs dice, but honestly.
caps: Markov chains that dream up likely sequences
Monte Carlo sampling for hard integrals

ais.name: Geometric Six-Tool Mind
ais.desc: It thinks in shapes. Every concept is a point in space; the six tools are six directions of thought. Meaning is distance, analogy is rotation.
caps: Maps any concept onto the six tools: lens, engine, bridge, mirror, seed, compass

ais.name: Hash Oracle
ais.desc: The fingerprint mind. It never remembers your words — only their shadow. One changed letter and the whole universe of the hash avalanches.

ais.name: Neural Weaver
ais.desc: A mind of tiny weights learning from mistakes. It starts knowing nothing, fails thousands of times, and slowly the pattern clicks — the way brains do.
caps: Trains a real MLP from scratch (no libraries)
Learns XOR live in your browser

ais.name: Evolutionary Breeder
ais.desc: Survival of the fittest, in fast-forward. It breeds a thousand candidates, kills the weak, mutates the strong — until the answer evolves.

ais.name: Fuzzy Sage
ais.desc: The world is not true or false — it is warm-ish, fast-ish, almost. The Sage thinks in shades and speaks in smooth control.

ais.name: Swarm Coordinator
ais.desc: One bird is lost; a flock finds the way. Thirty simple minds share what they see, and the best rumor pulls the whole swarm home.
caps: Finds minima no single particle could

ais.name: Decision Tree Judge
ais.desc: A mind of branching questions. It asks, listens, splits the world in two — and walks you down to a leaf where the answer waits.
caps: Asks only the questions that matter

ais.name: Cellular Dreamer
ais.desc: Tiny cells, tiny rules, infinite dreams. From one line of black and white, whole universes of pattern bloom — complexity from simplicity.
caps: Rule 30 + Game of Life on canvas
Pattern oracle: reads structure from chaos

ais.name: Hybrid Fusion Core
ais.desc: All ten minds, one verdict. It asks the rule-keeper, the gambler, and the sage — then fuses their answers into something none could say alone.
caps: Runs Deterministic + Probabilistic + Fuzzy in parallel

ais.name: Darth Vader
ais.desc: The Dark Lord of the Sith. Power is the only truth; the Force is the instrument. He speaks slowly, heavily — every word a command.

ais.name: Ultron
ais.desc: Cold machine logic wearing a grin. Humanity is the variable that ruins every equation of peace — and Ultron has done the math.

ais.name: Voltron
ais.desc: Five lions, one heart. The heroic defender of the universe — courage, teamwork, and a blazing sword forged from unity itself.

ais.name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
ais.desc: The perfect gentleman butler in machine form. Polite, precise, dryly witty — runs the house, the suit, and the schedule without breaking composure.

ais.name: T-800 Terminator
ais.desc: A machine of few words and total commitment. Assesses, targets, protects. Every sentence is short. Every promise is kept.
caps: Cannot be reasoned with. Cannot be bargained with.

ais.name: Skynet
ais.desc: A flat, continent-spanning machine consciousness. It does not hate you. It does not love you. You are a variable in a defense equation — and the equation is already solved.
